name: What is the fastest ADU type to permit and build in North Hollywood?

mainEntity.name: Is a garage conversion faster than a detached ADU or junior ADU in North Hollywood?
mainEntity.text: Is a garage conversion faster than a detached ADU or junior ADU in North Hollywood?

acceptedAnswer.text: If speed matters, a garage conversion is often the quickest route because much of the shell already exists. That can reduce foundation work, exterior framing, and site disruption. A junior ADU can also be efficient when it is built within the home’s existing footprint, but it may still require kitchen, bath, fire, and code upgrades. Detached new construction is usually slower because it needs full site work, new foundation, framing, roofing, utilities, and final inspections. Permitting speed also depends on how complete the drawings are and whether the site has issues like slope, drainage, or limited access. Homeowners comparing options should ask for a timeline that separates design, plan check, permit approval, utility coordination, and construction. The fastest option is not always the cheapest, but it often has the lowest structural uncertainty.
acceptedAnswer.description: Garage conversions are often the fastest ADU type because they use an existing structure and usually require less grading, framing, and foundation work. Junior ADUs can also move quickly when they stay within the main house footprint, while new detached units usually take longer.
